messages:
Maya P.: FYI: Saltwell (mid-market, finance vertical) has a renewal in ~5w. Noticed steep decline in calls since their ML lead left last week. Procurement asked for a brief cost/reliability note and mentioned an external bench test (GenForge). We should triage fast.
Luis G.: Can we confirm which endpoints dropped and whether it's a feature flag or auth issue? Any error spikes?
Maya P.: Console quick metrics:
`30d active keys: 980 -> 320 (-67%)`
`Top endpoints impacted: /chat-stream (-60%), /embed-bulk (-55%)`
`Errors: flat at 0.6%`
`Billing signal: committed seats unchanged but token spend down`
Hana T.: Sounds like usage drop not caused by infra. Likely internal prioritization + loss of ML owner. Champion (analytics director) still neutral-positive but not engaging.
Carl - CS Lead: Proposed play: rapid triage + counter-offer. Steps: immediate health call, competitor one-pager, quick cost optimization experiment, and an enablement workshop for the new PM. Assign owners below.
Maya P.: I'll own scheduling the health call with champion + new PM. Target: tomorrow 10am PT.
Luis G.: I'll run a lightweight perf & cost simulation against their top 20 prompts with a quantized variant and batched payloads. Need sample prompts + a small eval rubric for quality delta. ETA 72h.
eng-bot: Created ticket CS-9082: "Saltwell - cost/perf bakeoff" assigned to Luis G., due in 3 business days.
Jordan (RevOps): I'll stand by for a proposed short-term commercial concession and impact to ARR. If we move a discount, need Sales sign-off.
Hana T.: I'll draft a competitor snapshot vs GenForge: latency, token pricing, ease of switching (SDK + embeddings migration), and suggested messaging. Drop ETA: 48h.
Carl - CS Lead: For the health call, focus agenda: 1) surface timeline & procurement signal, 2) confirm who owns the POC/bench test, 3) offer a low-effort pilot to prove cost parity. Keep call under 30 min.
Maya P.: Scheduling note: champion is available tomorrow; new PM tentative. Will send calendar invite and CC Jordan + Sales.
Luis G.: If sample prompts show <5% quality degradation on quantized model while saving ~30% token cost, that's a retention lever. Will include diff examples in results.
Hana T.: I'll include migration checklist: embeddings swap steps, schema compatibility, and rollback plan. Also include suggested talking points for the champion to use internally vs procurement.
Maya P.: Action items recap:
- Collect sample prompts + confirm champion & new PM availability (Maya) - due EOD today
- Competitor snapshot (Hana) - due in 48h
- Quant + batching perf run & artifacts (Luis) - due in 3 business days (CS-9082)
- Draft short renewal concession options + approval path (Jordan + Sales) - draft in 48h
- Prep 60-min enablement workshop for new PM + engs (Carl) - schedule in 5 business days
Jordan (RevOps): I'll prepare the revenue impact scenarios and list approvers for any concession.
Maya P.: Thanks all. I'll paste call notes and procurement timeline here after the meeting. Please drop anything you hear from Saltwell procurement into this thread. :handshake:
